content: Bitwarden vault item types: Login (username/pw/passkey/TOTP), Card, Identity (name/address/contact), Secure Note, plus custom fields (text/hidden/checkbox/linked). 1Password has more granular categories (DB, Email Account, Membership, SSH Key) and Login items convert automatically from Password items. Community requests passkey as its own top-level item type rather than a sub-field of Login.
